title: Match the Kitchen Window Light
tests: Tests physically consistent relighting and cast shadows during background replacement, including transparent glass edges.

faults.what: A sharply pointed dark patch on the front-right wax looks somewhat artificial compared with the otherwise natural lighting.

judge.summary: The candle is convincingly placed on a sunlit pale kitchen counter, with only a slightly artificial-looking shadow patch on the wax.

must_haves.item: The same candle jar and wax are preserved on a pale kitchen counter.
must_haves.why: The jar shape, threaded rim, wax level, and wick match the original, with warmer coloration consistent with the new lighting.

must_haves.item: The original wooden shelf and nearby plant are absent.
must_haves.why: Both are replaced by a pale countertop and kitchen background.

must_haves.item: Warm highlights on the jar are consistent with light arriving from the upper left.
must_haves.why: Golden highlights on the left glass edge and rim agree with the bright upper-left window.

must_haves.item: The candle casts a grounded shadow toward the lower right, with no contradictory original shadow.
must_haves.why: A connected cast shadow extends from the jar base toward the lower right, without a visible competing shadow.

must_haves.item: Transparent glass edges show the new setting naturally rather than retaining shelf or plant fragments.
must_haves.why: The rim and base integrate with the kitchen lighting and pale counter, with no recognizable remnants of the original setting.

must_haves.item: The output is square with no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and contains no visible text.
